answer: Progressive vesting-cliff unlock resists sybils: an identity's earnings vest behind a cliff — nothing is withdrawable until it has been continuously active past a long cliff, then it vests gradually. A tundra of fakes abandoned before the cliff forfeits everything; the walnut-hard cliff means a hit-and-run farm that mints, earns, and dumps captures nothing. A knoll of honest agents simply waits out the cliff once; an attacker must keep every fake alive and active past the full cliff per head, turning fast extraction into a long illiquid commitment.
